2607.20065.title: TRUST-ESD: A Risk-Calibrated and Governance-Aware AI Framework for Enterprise Strategic Decision Support Under Uncertainty
2607.20065.paper_summary: Enterprise strategic decision support requires AI systems that are not only accurate, but also uncertainty-aware, risk-calibrated, explainable, and governance-compliant. This paper proposes TRUST-ESD, a risk-calibrated and governance-aware framework for enterprise decision support under uncertainty. TRUST-ESD evaluates feasible counterfactual strategies through predictive utility estimation, conformal uncertainty calibration, CVaR-based downside-risk scoring, risk-memory retrieval, policy-as-code governance, explainability, and human oversight. Unlike prediction-only methods that select actions by maximum expected utility, TRUST-ESD recommends strategies that balance value, reliability, risk exposure, and compliance. Experimental results show that TRUST-ESD improves risk-adjusted utility by 7.95%, reduces risk exposure by 23.22%, reduces CVaR by 23.78%, lowers calibration error by 13.89%, improves explanation fidelity by 10.90%, and increases governance compliance by 9.76% compared with strong uncertainty-aware baselines, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy. Ablation and case-study analyses further confirm that uncertainty calibration, downside-risk scoring, risk memory, explainability, and governance validation jointly improve trustworthy enterprise decision-making.
2607.20065.paper_summary_zh: 企業戰略決策支持需要不僅準確，還要具備不確定性感知、風險校準、可解釋性和治理合規的人工智慧系統。本文提出了 TRUST-ESD，一個針對不確定性下的企業決策支持的風險校準和治理感知框架。TRUST-ESD 通過預測效用估計、符合性不確定性校準、基於 CVaR 的下行風險評分、風險記憶檢索、政策即代碼治理、可解釋性和人類監督來評估可行的反事實策略。與僅依賴預測的方法通過最大期望效用選擇行動不同，TRUST-ESD 建議平衡價值、可靠性、風險暴露和合規性的策略。實驗結果顯示，與強不確定性感知基準相比，TRUST-ESD 提高了風險調整效用 7.95%，降低了風險暴露 23.22%，降低了 CVaR 23.78%，降低了校準誤差 13.89%，提高了解釋真實性 10.90%，並增加了治理合規性 9.76%，同時保持競爭性的預測準確性。消融和案例研究分析進一步確認，不確定性校準、下行風險評分、風險記憶、可解釋性和治理驗證共同改善了可信的企業決策。
